name: 纤长型枝垂樱

Elegant continuous branching grey-brown trunk with root flare, open lower trunk, densely covered small irregular blossom sprays, lacy negative spaces and visible branch forks. Complete consistent back and sides. No ground, pedestal, grass, sky, buildings, disconnected floating petals, text, or baked lighting. Keep the crown and branches connected, preserve an identifiable natural tree silhouette. Relatively narrow upright tree, graceful outward-arching fine limbs and hanging flower-laden branchlets; the lower one-third is open for pedestrians.
